node.statement: Validated nodes 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 exhaust the proposed direct and zero-padded applications: they show respectively that compatibility and equality of the padded norms with r are unavailable, and that the compressed-product and E_11 matrix-norm identifications are unavailable. Hence no allowed input closes the norm bound. A positive proof requires registry-level provisioning of amplification/compression naturality together with the relevant zero-padding norm identification, followed by rewiring this shard's dependency list.
